integrity: Complete proof with reproducible standard-library checker; the original one-resolution gauge is credited, the two-resolution compatibility and converse are the asserted contribution.
scientific_limitations: Population first intensities only; strictly positive continuous polynomially upper-bounded spectra, two distinct complete Gaussian resolutions; no finite-sample inverse stability, no higher-order zero process claim, no spectra with zeros.
title: Two-resolution rigidity and Gaussian-periodic aliases of spectrogram zero intensities
